brief:
Israeli politician Moshe Redman, a prominent leader of demonstrations against judicial overhauls and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government, launched a sharp attack on Netanyahu's wife Sara and son Yair, the Shehab Wire reported. The criticism surfaced amid an ongoing controversy concerning government spending, though specific details of the allegations were not immediately clear from available accounts.

Redman has emerged as one of the most visible figures organizing street protests against Netanyahu's judicial reform initiative. His public denunciation of the prime minister's family members represents an intensification of political conflict within Israel's debate over the government's judicial changes and broader policy direction. The attack underscores deepening divisions between the protest movement and the Netanyahu administration.
